Cisco CATALYST End of Life (EOL) Dates and EOSL Dates

  1. Home
  2. Cisco
  3. CATALYST

163 Cisco CATALYST models have reached End of Life (EOL) and End of Support (EOS), including 7600 Catalyst 6500 IPSec VPN Services Module (EOL date: May 31, 2011) — no longer supported. Cisco CATALYST Catalyst 3650 reaches its End of Support date on Oct 31, 2026 — plan your upgrade path now. CATALYST Catalyst 1000 Series is the current supported model — 14 models in active support. Also see Cisco lifecycle dates for related end-of-life information.

Cisco CATALYST End of Life & Support Summary

Which Cisco CATALYST Products Are Currently Supported?

Cisco CATALYST has 14 supported models in active support. Catalyst 1000 Series is the latest. Catalyst 2960X Product Family is also supported until Oct 31, 2027. Note: Catalyst 3650 support ends on Oct 31, 2026 — plan your upgrade before then. Also see Cisco MERAKI end of support life for related end-of-life information.

Cisco CATALYST Products Nearing End of Life

1 CATALYST model is reaching End of Life (EOL) within 6 months. Catalyst 3650 reaches End of Support on Oct 31, 2026. Upgrade to Catalyst 1000 Series to stay on a supported model. Also see Cisco HYPERFLEX end of service life for related end-of-life information.

Cisco CATALYST End of Life (EOL) Product History

163 Cisco CATALYST models have reached End of Life (EOL) — no longer receiving updates or support. 7600 Catalyst 6500 IPSec VPN Services Module reached EOL on May 31, 2011. Catalyst 1000 Series is the recommended replacement for users still running End of Life hardware. Also see Cisco DIRECTOR end of life dates for related end-of-life information.
